opening.text: Hello. I'm Jae-hyuk Choi, a mathematics teacher at Posan High School.

tagline.text: I have taught mathematics at middle and high schools in Daegu since twenty twelve. What began as GeoGebra-based lessons grew into Python and AI mathematics, and today I solve classroom and school-office problems by building web services myself. What I learn, I pass on through teacher training and student lectures.

timeline.car-2012.text: In twenty twelve, I began my teaching career at Siji Middle School.

timeline.car-2014.text: From twenty fourteen, I taught at Daegu Seobu High School.

timeline.car-2019.text: From twenty nineteen, I was head of curriculum at Daegu Science High School, where I launched and taught an Artificial Intelligence course.

timeline.car-2025.text: In twenty twenty-five, I was seconded to Kyungpook National University to complete the IBEC programme.

timeline.car-2026.text: Since twenty twenty-six, I have been teaching IB Mathematics and AI Mathematics at Posan High School.

pillars.text: My work has three parts: teaching mathematics, training and lecturing on AI convergence education, and building education services.

ending.text: If you're curious about using AI tools in school education, feel free to get in touch.
